entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. J. Sahoo, learned counsel has entered appearance on behalf of the informant by filing Vaklatanama in Court.
The same is taken on record.
The name of Mr. Sahoo, learned counsel be reflected in the file, cause list as well as webportal of this Court.
2. Heard learned counsels for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

3. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R. Case No.79 of 2025 pending on the file of learned Addl. Sessions Judge-Cum- Special Court under POCSO Act, Nayagarh, arising out of Odagaon P.S. Case No.345 of 2025 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 294/ 376(2)(m)/506 of IPC and Section 6 of Protection of children from sexual offences Act (Amended)2012, 2019.

entities.text: Protection of children from sexual offences Act (Amended)2012, 2019
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the Informant submits that in the meanwhile Odagaon P.S. Case No.369 of 2025 has been instituted against the present Petitioner, inter alia, on the ground that they are threatening the informant and forcing them to withdraw and the case which is subject matter of Rajt Kumar Sahoo vs State Of Odisha ....

entities.text: Rajt Kumar Sahoo vs State Of Odisha
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Opposite Parties on 23 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/80859424/
1 consideration in ABLAPL No.14342 of 2025.
5. Per contra, learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that the same is being resorted to just to prejudice to this Court.

6. This Court perused the allegations as in the F.I.R.
7.
Considering the nature of allegations, this Court is not inclined to entertain the application for pre-arrest bail.
However, in the event the Petitioner surrenders before the learned Court in seisin and moves an application for his release on bail, the same shall be considered on its own merit.
8. Accordingly, the ABLAPL stands disposed of.
Signed by: SOUMYA RANJAN SAMAL (V. NARASINGH)
